This '''hot sauce''' tastes very much like Tabasco and other vinegar-based cayenne [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|hot sauces]].

== Ingredients ==
*¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Malt vinegar|malt vinegar]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients. Store indefinitely at room temperature in a squirt bottle.
